name: FieldSense Synthetic Audio Fixtures
preprocessing_steps: Deterministic harmonic synthesis + controlled SNR/clipping/attenuation augmentation
limitations: Synthetic waveforms validate DSP quality checks, resampling, and noise pipelines only; not valid for real speech WER benchmarking.

name: FieldSense Synthetic Forms & Flashcards
preprocessing_steps: Grayscale PGM decode + 3x3 Laplacian sharpness + luminance histogram
limitations: 3 synthetic document/flashcard fixtures for verifying OCR, PII redaction, and low-light blur flagging.

name: Google FLEURS Multilingual Speech
preprocessing_steps: Resample 16kHz mono, Unicode NFKC normalization, duration filter [0.5s, 30s]
limitations: Read-speech benchmark; does not reflect spontaneous noisy rural clinic speech without noise augmentation. Download requires ~2 GB per language.

name: Mozilla Common Voice Corpus
split: validated / train / dev / test (not yet downloaded)
preprocessing_steps: ffmpeg MP3->WAV decode, deduplicate repeated prompts, speaker-disjoint split
limitations: Crowdsourced read prompts; Assamese coverage is sparse; requires accent and age metadata audit.

name: OpenSLR Indic Corpora (SLR-53 / SLR-102 / SLR-103)
preprocessing_steps: Verify MD5 checksums, resample to 16kHz, strip punctuation variants
limitations: Studio-like clean acoustic conditions; requires controlled background noise augmentation for field testing.

name: FUNSD Form Understanding in Noisy Scanned Documents
preprocessing_steps: Deskewing, CLAHE contrast normalization, bounding box alignment
limitations: English archival forms only; non-commercial license; does not cover Indic scripts or handwritten clinic forms.
